explication: This repository is primarily Recog’s fingerprint content: XML patterns identify products, services, operating systems, and hardware from probe responses. The documented user workflow is to provide response data to the match tool, which uses the fingerprint corpus to produce identification results. The repository also includes fingerprint-management commands and a CPE-update utility. Source excerpts are limited, so links for those utilities are not inferred from filenames; the documented matching relationship is shown explicitly.
